title: int:Community
description: An energy community operating at one or more pilot sites. Subclass of cim:Organisation.

communityId.description: Primary identifier. IRI: int:communityId. UUID v4.

communityType.description: Legal organisational type per EU energy community legislation. IRI: int:communityType.

legalStructure.description: Official legal structure of the community. Free text. IRI: int:legalStructure.

communityOperatorId.description: FK to operator Actor. IRI: int:hasOperator. UUID v4.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. IRI: int:country.

latitude.description: Anonymised representative latitude. IRI: int:latitude. Unit: decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Anonymised representative longitude. IRI: int:longitude. Unit: decimal degrees.

gridConnectionVoltageLevel.description: Nominal grid connection voltage in volts. IRI: cim:BaseVoltage. Unit: V.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for billing and trading. IRI: int:currency.

marketMechanism.description: Energy sharing or trading mechanism. IRI: int:marketMechanism.

co2EmissionFactor.description: Grid CO2 emission factor. IRI: int:co2EmissionFactor. Unit: gCO2/kWh.

yearEstablished.description: Year the community was formally established. IRI: int:yearEstablished.

siteId.description: FK to Site. IRI: int:hasSite. UUID v4.

validFrom.description: Start of community-site association. IRI: int:validFrom. ISO 8601 with timezone.

validUntil.description: End of community-site association. NULL if still active. IRI: int:validUntil.

operationalRole.description: Role of this community at this site. IRI: int:operationalRole.

totalMembers.description: Total number of enrolled members. IRI: int:totalMembers.

totalSites.description: Total number of associated Sites. IRI: int:totalSites.
